Karthik —

Thanks for the recap. A few clarifications and requests from the InfoSec side: 

1) SOC 2: we need the latest SOC 2 Type II report (2024 or 2025 if available). We prefer the full report redacted for customer-identifying details.
2) Incident response / breach notification: please provide your standard timeline for detection -> internal escalation -> customer notification. We typically require a maximum notification window in contracts (48 vs 72 hours) — please state your standard SLA and whether exceptions are possible.
3) BCP/DR: a 1–2 page RTO/RPO summary and the location of runbook artifacts is fine. We will ask for evidence of recent DR exercises if available.
4) Vendor questionnaire: we run a standard security questionnaire (link below). Is there a preferred security point-of-contact who will own the questionnaire? We need the questionnaire completed or a status update by 2025-11-25 to keep the procurement timeline.

Questionnaire link: https://vendor-forms.healthbridge.com/questionnaire/REDWOOD-2025

Lastly, please confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed key (CMK) integrations for the dedicated/private deployments — that will affect our classification for HIPAA.

Samir Patel
Head of Information Security
HealthBridge Systems
